projects.title: Apex Analytics — Performance Telemetry Platform
projects.summary: End-to-end design system and responsive front-end customer portal for a high-growth cloud telemetry service, featuring real-time data streaming and custom charts.
projects.outcome: Result: +34% user retention, sub-100ms render speeds
projects.problem: Apex needed to replace an uninspired internal dashboard with an enterprise-grade customer portal that could handle real-time data streaming without lagging.
projects.solution: Designed and engineered a modular dashboard with customizable KPI widgets, dark mode optimizations, and high-performance SVG chart rendering.
results: +34% increase in daily active user retention
Helped close 12 new enterprise pilot contracts

projects.title: Lumina Maison — Luxury Architectural Goods
projects.summary: Bespoke digital boutique combining tactile editorial typography, curated storytelling galleries, and an optimized frictionless mobile slide-out bag.
projects.outcome: Result: +62% mobile conversion, +$85 Average Order Value
projects.problem: The client had exquisite handcrafted home objects but suffered from a generic e-commerce template with a clunky mobile checkout flow.
projects.solution: Crafted an editorial-style e-commerce layout emphasizing tactile photography, warm minimalist typography, and a frictionless slide-out bag checkout.
results: Featured on multiple design inspiration galleries

projects.title: Aura Health — Telehealth & Patient Portal
projects.summary: A secure, accessible appointment booking engine and telemedicine video interface engineered for patient privacy and frictionless smartphone accessibility.
projects.outcome: Result: Sub-3 min booking flow, 100% WCAG AA compliant
projects.problem: Patients faced excessive friction scheduling virtual doctor appointments and accessing confidential health vitals on smartphones.
projects.solution: Architected a mobile-first, HIPAA-compliant patient dashboard with one-tap appointment booking, secure file uploads, and encrypted video consultation integration.
results: Average appointment booking time cut down to under 3 minutes
100% WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance audit passed

projects.solution: Built an immersive, dark-mode agency showcase featuring smooth page transitions, typography animations, and optimized WebGL interactive elements.
results: Nominated for Awwwards Site of the Day
Organic inbound project inquiries doubled within 60 days
